_doc: Routes that answer anonymous GETs ON PURPOSE. The perimeter collector flags every other 2xx/5xx it gets with no credentials. One entry per decided door: host and path accept fnmatch wildcards, but prefer exact paths so a new route under the same prefix still gets flagged. Every entry needs a why and who decided; an entry nobody can defend should be deleted, not kept.

routes.why: the login page needs the auth mode and provider ids before anyone is signed in. The ROUTE is public by design; its VALUE matters: auth_mode dev = passwordless email login.
